//: Full-permission settings for Claude Code on Windows, desktop Code tab and CLI.
//1: Copy into ~/.claude/settings.json (user-global) or a project .claude/settings.json. Back up the existing file first.
//2: bypassPermissions has no prompt-injection protection. Owner accepts risk; existing ask/deny rules still apply.
//3: allow rules have no effect in bypassPermissions; platform exceptions and explicit rules can still prompt.

permissions.//ask: Empty by design. Add entries here only if YOU decide a specific action should prompt.
permissions.//deny: Empty by design. Add entries here only if YOU decide a specific action should be hard-blocked.
permissions.//additionalDirectories: Broadens the working scope beyond the launch cwd. EDIT THESE to your own roots  -  the entries below are placeholders, NOT real paths. Replace YOUR_USERNAME with your Windows account name (or remove the entry). Setup-Autonomy.ps1 does not write this list, so set it yourself if you want it.

//enableAllProjectMcpServers: Auto-approve connected project MCP servers  -  fewer interruptions.
